files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from phase-lanes by the note-writer: the dashed divider here separates userspace from kernel space, a privilege boundary, not a time axis; there are no phases, no Gantt blocks, only three numbered limitation callouts on an ordinary stack diagram.
templates.what_to_learn: Read this as a layered or host-device-style figure instead: stack userspace over kernel space across one dashed boundary the way a PCIe or OS boundary is drawn elsewhere, and overlay numbered red-italic callouts directly on the components a limitation applies to.
